draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 39th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 34 at DE. He went 32nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2019, 7th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: retired. Last NFL action came in 2025. 82 career games and 45 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2022. Weak spots: sacks 0.0 (7th percentile), season snap share 13.4% (12th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 0.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
